cards.claim: William Carrier is a winger who recorded assists, hits, shots on net, and a plus-minus rating in a game against the Sharks, which are statistics and roles associated with the sport of hockey.
cards.quote: , 2024 Carrier notched an assist and three hits in Tuesday 's 3-2 win over the Sharks . Carrier snapped a nine-game point drought with the helper . He had eight shots on net , a minus-3 rating and 44 hits in that span , channeling the more physical elements of his playing style . The 29-year-old winger has six points , 26 shots , 90 hits and a plus-2 rating through 28 appearances this season , so a return to the 20-point mark seems unlikely , though not impossible .
